scope: The current locked Wikimedia English Wiktionary to Rich EN→ZH POC pipeline.

blockers.evidence: The pinned WikitextProcessor fetches interwiki siteinfo during phase one; pinned Wiktextract may make conditional live Wikidata/SPARQL requests during phase two. These responses are not locked or captured, so the current pipeline is not fully input-locked.
The current Wiktionary projection has no authoritative sense-level association for entry-level translations. It does not guess a definition-sense join.

Pinned Wiktextract requires the Brown corpus at build time. Its locked NLTK data index says it may be used for non-commercial purposes, so build-use approval and retained-field/license implications remain unresolved. The corpus is not shipped or bundled.
Sol stopped the experimental second phase after a partial observation. No full-export, benchmark, or pack-size claim is available.

claim: This decision rejects the current source pipeline. It does not approve a dictionary source, production pack, license, or product release.
